causal_edges.explanation: The ticket was initially routed incorrectly, which led to confusion in the handling process.
The incorrect routing caused a delay in resolution provision as the escalation was expected from the wrong agent.
Resolution details were delayed, affecting the update process back to the customer.
The delay in resolution and update affected the final feedback and closure confirmation.

root_cause_explanation: The ticket was incorrectly routed to the Ticket Manager instead of the Technical Support Specialist.
